question: Two identical bar magnets, each of mass $m$, length $L$, and magnetic moment $M$, are joined rigidly at their centers to form a cross at $90^\circ$ to each other. The system is suspended from its center of mass by a frictionless pivot so that it can rotate freely in a horizontal plane. A uniform horizontal magnetic field $B$ exists in the region. In the stable equilibrium position, one of the magnets makes an angle of $45^\circ$ with the field.
